items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you guys get that from Ahmet Ertegun from Atlantic Records... [INTERVIEWEE] Well I’m not sure, you know I’m not sure where they got Sir Ian.

ctx.x: and this scene depended on it. Luckily on the DVD you can see it as a bonus scene. But they just sort of made an effort to leave me in as much as they could once they had cut my key scene. But between all my various scenes, one was in a record store that they did leave in, the in-store signing, and then some remnants of the one the night before where I have to talk them into going to a radio station and then we had to cut the radio station. Two days work on the film. All different — you know no written lines…
Did you guys get that from Ahmet Ertegun from Atlantic Records, did you think that that was like an appropriate?
Well I’m not sure, you know I’m not sure where they got Sir Ian.
